Jeeves Takes Charge is a fun, very reverent take on the works of P.G Wodehouse, with a great physical performance from Sam Harrison.

cn.t: Sam Harrison's virtuosic one-man performance earns praise in this nostalgic Wodehouse adaptation, though critics are divided on whether the reverent, old-fashioned material connects beyond devoted fans of the source.
